instruction.text: Drag the periods of Egyptian history to the correct parts of the timeline.

hint.text: When talking about years with BC, the higher the number, the further back in history it is.

feedback.end: These three kingdoms are the times when ancient Egypt was unified under one rule. The periods in between were defined by civil war or invasion.

atoms.b: The Old Kingdom is when most of the biggest ((++pyramids cylinders)) were made.
The Middle Kingdom was a time of artistic development. Many statues and artworks were made to ((++honour bully)) the gods and pharaohs.

hint.label: Pharaoh
hint.text: Pharaoh is the word for an ancient Egyptian ruler.

atoms.b: Most of the surviving ((++artefacts artists)) we have from ancient Egypt are from the New Kingdom — a lot of them from the tomb of the pharaoh Tutankhamun.

instruction.text: Match the ancient Egyptian monument to its name.

b.sound: The pyramid has four triangular sides.
The sphinx has the head of a woman and the body of a lion.
There are four pillars outside the temple.

instruction.text: Select the item that was part of ancient Egyptian burial rituals.

atoms.a: A sarcophagus was a fancy ancient coffin that an important person might be buried in.
Canopic jars were special ornamental jars used to store the organs of dead people.
